name: Amelia
source:
One half of an infamous duo.

She works as a hostess alongside [url=https://vndb.org/c144446]Zoe[/url], pretending to be her twin in order to lure more customers. Years ago, she and her "sister" were arrested in connection with a series of serial killings. However, someone convinced the police to drop the charges, and they were released. Despite this incident, Zoe and Amelia didn't lose clients because their charm is too strong to be damaged by a wrongful arrest. It was a wrongful arrest, right?

Despite not being real sisters, Amelia shares a deep bond with Zoe and she cares about her. It seems she have the upper hand when it comes the duo dynamics, which give her the final say in the crucial decisions.
